2104-2707-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
2104-2707-8267.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

Repeat each combat phase.

When the token dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.

Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.

1479-5233-5671.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, The Necrobloom, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.

Repeat from step 2.

610-2164-3799.description:

Resolve Chain of Plasma, dealing 3 damage to Stuffy Doll, discarding a card, and copying Chain of Plasma with the same target.
Stuffy Doll and Archmage Emeritus trigger.
Resolve Stuffy Doll's trigger, dealing 3 damage to the chosen opponent.
Resolve Archamage Emeritus's trigger, drawing a card.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have one card remaining in library, decline to copy Chain of Plasma.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Suncleanser trigger, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
